report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. The deployment record shows only order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and v2.0.0 idle. No checkout error is observed; the hypothesis is contradicted rather than confirmed.
missing_evidence: Checkout error telemetry (non-2xx or failed spans) within the incident window
Logs for order/checkout services (ev-...-logs-order was excluded)
Deployment history showing a version change preceding any observed errors
Metrics for checkout/payment/inventory services, not only order
